outcome: HR Lead decides payroll corrections; the named Finance reader confirms the HR export
acceptance_criteria: As `hr-lead` at `http://localhost:4990/finance/payroll/corrections/<case>` (mock 4991), the page lists correction #14 and #13 each with "Requested 10 Nov" and "08 Nov" and "WAITING FOR YOU", and shows "As of" — verify: open the page; `e2e/payroll-corrections.spec.ts`.
The page shows no masked staff reference (`S-●●●`), no "3 corrections" count, no story text and no Note field — verify: e2e asserts those strings absent; DOM check.
Selecting #14 shows entity PSL-NG, period 2026-10 and the four field words; "Record decision" is disabled until a verdict and the proof (id 301) are both chosen — verify: e2e.

Choosing Approve plus proof 301 and pressing Record decision sends exactly one `POST /api/v1/projects/<case>/hr-disclosures` with `action:"decide_correction"`, `revision:7`, `request_id:14`, `verdict:"approve"`, `successor_id:null`, a uuid `operation_key` and `evidence_id:301`, then re-reads, and #14 leaves the waiting list — verify: network panel; unit test on `correctionCommands.body()`.
Return and Reject send `verdict:"return"` and `"reject"`; a correction whose `corrections[]` entry has `successor_id: 88` sends `successor_id:88` — verify: unit tests.
While a decide is in flight the button is disabled; a double press sends one request — verify: unit test with a deferred mock.

A network failure on decide shows "We couldn't confirm. Check before trying again." and pressing again re-sends the same `operation_key`; after a 200 or 409 the next attempt uses a new key — verify: unit test on key handling; mock replay returns the first result.

A 409 (stale revision 6) keeps the chosen verdict, re-reads, and shows "This changed while you were looking. Check it and decide again."; no success message appears — verify: mock scenario `stale`; e2e.
A decide 200 followed by a failed re-read shows "Recorded. We couldn't refresh the list" and does not claim the new state — verify: mock scenario `reread_fails`.
`csrf_failed` 403 refreshes the session and says "Press Record decision again"; it does not show the no-access state — verify: mock scenario; unit test.

Failure journey, no HR authority: signed in as `plain-member`, opening the page shows only "This isn't available to you." with no list, counts, ids, entity names or fields; the browser makes no write and the page renders no payroll value; a direct URL for a contract the person cannot see (`.../hr-disclosures/999`, 404) shows the identical wording — verify: open both as `plain-member`; e2e compares text and asserts the DOM holds no entity, period or field words.
As `hr-lead` the "Confirm receipt" control and the rows table never render, and no request to `snapshots/{id}/rows` or `finance-acknowledgement` is made — verify: network panel; e2e.

As `hr-lead`, if `actions[]` lacks `decide_correction` the three verdicts and Record decision are disabled with "You can't decide corrections here" (text from the read-driven `disabledReason`) — verify: unit test with `actions:[]`.
With `proofs.decide_correction` empty, Record decision is disabled with "No proof is available to attach." — verify: unit test.

As `finance-recipient`, the "HR export awaiting your confirmation" section shows snapshot 201, "As of", "Partial", "30 rows", a rows table of at most 25 rows with "Next page" using `next_page`, and `monthly_pay:null` reads "Not recorded", never 0 — verify: e2e; unit test on the row mapper.

"Confirm receipt" sends one `POST /api/v1/work/4301/department-handoff/finance-acknowledgement` with body exactly `{snapshot_id:201, revision:3}`, then re-reads and shows "Receipt recorded" only when `receipt` is not null — verify: network panel; unit test; mock scenario where `receipt` stays null shows no tick.
A rows 403 or 404 for a reader who is not the named recipient shows "This isn't available to you." inside that section only and draws no table — verify: mock scenario; e2e.
Rows are never summed, no totals are computed on the client, and a `completeness:"unknown"` shows "Not known" — verify: unit test; grep shows no arithmetic on row money fields.

No payroll value (a row field, an entity name, a snapshot id) appears in the URL, document title, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage` or a console message — verify: e2e inspects them after opening a snapshot.

Empty and loading states: `pending_corrections:[]` shows "No corrections are waiting for you."; a pending request shows the skeleton; a failed refresh keeps the last list with "We couldn't refresh" — verify: mock scenarios.

On a 390 px-wide viewport the list shows as rows and the decision panel opens as its own view with the same controls; no horizontal scroll — verify: Playwright mobile viewport; screenshot compared with `SCR-37-mobile.dc.html`.

The same page against live Django 8030 for an HR account shows the same fields as `GET /projects/{case_id}/hr-disclosures` — verify: compare the page with the curl JSON using the session; typecheck and `delivery/checks.sh` pass.

Unit tests exist for: the pending list mapper, `correctionCommands` bodies and key handling, error mapping for 401/403/404/409/422/429/503/network, and the rows mapper (null handling) — verify: `npm test` shows them.

risk.rationale: High. This feature shows restricted payroll data (bank account, home address, date of birth, pay fields) and writes an approval verdict that is hard to undo. Both fall under INV-RESTRICTED and the access rules in screens-e-finance-payroll.md (SCR-37). Surfaces are ui, api, security and auth. The contract-change surface is there because item shapes are untyped, so the builder must pin them against real responses and flag any gap.
